name: web-standards
description: Binding engineering standards for web projects: frontend (React + Vite + TypeScript + nginx + Docker + MapLibre) and backend (Go + Gin microservices).

plugins.name: frontend-standards
plugins.description: Frontend engineering standard: React 19 + Vite 8 + TypeScript, feature-based structure, TanStack Query, MapLibre GPU rendering rules, i18n key parity, SEO without stale builds, Docker + nginx templates, CI gates. 806 rules in 27 documents, 21 decision records, 5 audit tools.

plugins.name: backend-standards
plugins.description: Backend engineering standard: Go + Gin microservices behind a gateway. Clean architecture, API contract, security, resilience, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, cache, observability, Docker, CI. 594 rules in 25 documents, 18 decision records, 5 audit tools (standards, secrets, Postman collection, load test, version advisory).
